name: Side Plank
variation: Forearm side plank with straight stacked legs; one side demonstrated, then repeat on the other side. This is a timed hold, not repeated hip dips.
camera: Fixed front-side three-quarter, head left and feet right; near side of abdomen visible, support forearm and stacked feet unobscured.

muscles.note: Qualitative hierarchy, not measured activation; no through-body view.

frames.label: Set your support
frames.cue: Place your elbow under your shoulder; stack feet.
frames.state: Side-lying with hips resting on floor, legs straight and stacked, lower forearm on floor, upper hand on hip.

frames.label: Lift your hips
frames.cue: Press through your forearm and lift your hips.
frames.state: Hips halfway raised; support forearm and lower shoe remain planted, no torso twist.

frames.label: Find your line
frames.cue: Align your head, hips and feet without twisting.
frames.state: Full side plank, straight shoulder-hip-ankle line, elbow under shoulder, upper hand on hip.

frames.label: Hold and breathe
frames.cue: Hold this position for time, breathing normally.
frames.state: Same full side plank. The still depicts a sustained hold, not a pulse.

frames.label: Lower with control
frames.cue: After your hold, lower your hips slowly.
frames.state: Same halfway position on the controlled exit.

frames.label: Rest and switch
frames.cue: Rest your hips, then repeat on the other side.
frames.state: Return to setup; pause or switch sides for the next timed hold.
